'''Polmanar''' was a textile-[[Factory/Legends|manufacturing]] world located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region. In addition to textiles, [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] grew [[Reedug/Legends|reedug narcotic]] among Polmanar's warm hills.<ref name="GG" />

Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Imperials attempted to force a tariff on reedug farmers. Angry with the taxes and desperate for medical supplies, the farmers enlisted the help of local guerrillas, who were soon reinforced by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] armaments. Before long, the Empire realized an attempted blockade was not worth the effort and left Polmanar in Rebel control. After the small Imperial occupation force retreated, the planet continued to be governed democratically.<ref name="GG" />
